richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Erode

c: Erode's textile units, turmeric traders and growing residential layouts give us three kinds of buyers for outdoor gym equipment. Business owners want a fitness corner for workers, housing developers want an amenity for buyers, and schools want equipment for their grounds. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness machines to all of them, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,030 km from Erode, and sent by road.

Many sites here are long and narrow, such as a strip along a compound wall or the edge of a layout park. That shape works well for outdoor gym equipment if the stations are set in a line with clear space between them. We plan the line for you on a layout drawing. Our installation team or a dealer in Tamil Nadu then installs the machines, grouted or self-standing, after you approve the drawing and the quote.

items.q: Can an outdoor gym fit along a compound wall?
items.a: Yes. We place the machines in a line with clear space around each one and mark the positions on a layout drawing. Slim machines such as twisters and leg lift posts suit these strips.

items.q: Is outdoor gym equipment suitable for factory workers?
items.a: Yes. The machines need no trainer or settings, so workers can use them during breaks or after a shift. Pick a mix of strength and stretching machines.
